Welcome to my blog! This is my first post where I’ll introduce myself and share what you can expect from my future posts.

Who Am I?

I’m Om Choudhary, a software developer passionate about web technologies and creating engaging user experiences. I work primarily with React, TypeScript, and various modern web technologies.

What Will I Write About?

In this blog, I’ll be sharing:

  • Web development tips and tricks
  • My experiences with different technologies
  • Best practices in software development
  • Tutorials and how-to guides

Tech Stack Behind This Blog

This blog is built with:

  • Gatsby.js for static site generation
  • TypeScript for type-safe code
  • Tailwind CSS for styling
  • Auth0 for authentication

Stay tuned for more posts about web development, software engineering, and technology in general!
